recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future changes to restore or further explain goal outcome modeling should be handled under the later R6 Goal outcome/removal decisions rather than this DSTU2 wording clarification.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU2 Patient Care issue requesting the Goal.outcome short description be clarified from "What was end result of goal?" to "What result was achieved regarding the goal?"
initial_application: Commit f39dde8e171836d3345715f788c746e0a1624492 applied the accepted wording to the Goal spreadsheet source in 2016, and later source rework carried that wording into the StructureDefinition source while Goal.outcome still existed.
additional_context: Goal is active in source/fhir.ini, but FHIR-37262 later removed Goal.outcome and commit 0d8e3756353bd8c0e93994eea043a54216ae2f37 commented the element out. FHIR-53828 subsequently added current Goal narrative guidance directing implementers to resource-pertainsToGoal for measurement, achievement, or progress toward a goal; FHIR-54318 duplicates that migration-guidance concern.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because there is no active current Goal.outcome short description to correct, and the commented historical block already contains the accepted FHIR-11338 wording.
